preconditions.description: The number of lamps n is between 2 and 200,000.
The list a contains exactly n - 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: Each element in a is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.splitlines()) == n and all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in return_value.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating impossibility, or a valid scheme with n lines where the first line is the root lamp index and the next n-1 lines are unique pairs of connected lamps.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies (len(set(int(line.split()[0]) for line in return_value.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1 and len(set(int(line.split()[1]) for line in return_value.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1)
postconditions.description: If a valid scheme is returned, each lamp (except the root) appears exactly once as a main lamp and exactly once as an auxiliary lamp.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies (all(int(line.split()[0]) in {int(a[i]) for i in range(n - 1)} for line in return_value.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If a valid scheme is returned, each main lamp in the output corresponds to a main lamp in the input list a.
